name: cadence
description: Discussion-driven dev workflow plugin (Claude Code + OpenCode first-class, Codex CLI compat layer) for recording, consolidating, and retrieving session decisions and TODOs.

interface.shortDescription: Discussion-driven dev workflow for session decisions and TODOs.
interface.longDescription: Cadence captures decisions and TODOs from Claude Code and Codex sessions into project archives, with built-in subagent dispatch for context-isolated retrieval and consolidation. It supports compacted contexts, session resets, and cross-session continuity.
